paragraphs: R' Yehudah ben Antigonus. See the entry R' Yehudah bar Titus.[^1]

notes.text: Antigonus and Titus are distinct supplied patronymics; ben in the heading and bar in the target are preserved. Both abbreviated titles remain R'.
